name: Left Exit 12 Off Ramp
look: A highway scene. A green overhead sign with a yellow tab reading LEFT and a plate reading EXIT 12 shows one arrow going straight and one curving off to the right. Below it, a dark blue sedan swerves sharply onto the exit ramp, tires smoking.
use: The straight arrow is labeled with the sensible or expected choice, the exit arrow with the impulsive or ridiculous one, and the swerving car is whoever abruptly bails out to take the exit.
slots: the sensible choice (straight arrow on the sign)
the impulsive choice (exit arrow curving right)
who swerves for the exit (the car)
examples: Tell a long story about my cousin
describe: car swerving onto the highway exit at the last second
green road sign with a straight arrow and an exit arrow
blue car making a sharp turn onto the off ramp
highway sign that says left exit 12 and a sedan skidding
vehicle suddenly veering off the freeway instead of going straight
